gaps.sentence: I'd have helped if I ___ about the problem.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

gaps.sentence: Unless the strike ___, flights will be grounded all weekend.
gaps.hint: unless plus a present passive verb
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' clauses use the present simple, here in the passive: is called off.

gaps.sentence: He wouldn't be so tired today ___ so late last night.
gaps.explanation: Past condition with present result: if + past perfect, would + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ you at the airport last week, but I was abroad.
gaps.hint: regret about a missed past meeting
gaps.explanation: Regret about something that did not happen takes 'wish' plus the past perfect: had met.

gaps.sentence: If this medicine ___ relief within an hour, call me back.
gaps.explanation: Conditional instructions use the present simple in the if-clause: does not bring.

gaps.sentence: Had I realized the danger, I ___ the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Had I realized …' = 'If I had realized …' + would have cancelled.

gaps.sentence: I would tell you if I ___, but it is a secret.
gaps.explanation: An unreal present condition takes the past simple after 'if': knew.

gaps.sentence: He always carries a power bank in case his phone ___.
gaps.hint: in case plus the present simple
gaps.explanation: 'In case' takes the present simple for things that might happen: dies.
